nodes.description: Public payable transfer that forwards msg.sender as _from into transferFrom, enabling arbitrary sender-controlled transfers.
Internal view whitelist gate: returns true for owner, hardcoded UNI/router constants, tradeAddress or canSale[_from] before any balance checks, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transferFrom that decrements allowance and balances without SafeMath and calls ensure(), which can be bypassed by whitelisted/_from==UNI addresses.
Public approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no validation.
Internal view sale-condition check using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum[_from].
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker/owner supplied address a with data b, allowing full storage takeover.
Public mint: owner or a hardcoded address can set arbitrary balanceOf[spender] and whitelist canSale[spender]=true.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale limits.
Owner-only batch transfer computing total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath (overflow) and performing unchecked internal balance arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry used by ensure().
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation via keccak256; used to compute _UNI whitelist address inside ensure().
Payable constructor setting owner=msg.sender, totalSupply, balances, name, symbol and unlimited router allowance.
Private owner address; sole authority for delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress, _mints.
Public balance ledger mutated directly in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public allowance ledger mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Private whitelist mapping consulted by ensure() and written by _mints.
Private per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition().

Arbitrary low-level delegatecall executed in the token's storage context (a.delegatecall(b)).
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend with no SafeMath, allowing arithmetic overflow.
